notes: This manifest describes the adapter subset, not everything the research engine can do.
Only normalized lengths, degrees, and a positive full cyclic input in a right-handed XY frame.
Fixed-only and optimized-only ground requests are rejected; hybrid with one fixed seed is supported.
Identical per-target position tolerances are combined with the global point ceiling using the stricter value.
Only soft worst-target transmission goals and report-only compactness requests are supported.
Custom bounds, objective weights, timing, budgets and unsupported output options are rejected.
No validation level above kinematic_candidate is accepted, and a prepared plan is not a validated mechanism.
Fixed representative reservation is disabled so rejected reference designs cannot bypass selected eligibility.
